title: Resumable Production promotion across offline local Staging and advancing main

phases.objective: Preserve an immutable governed Production candidate when local Staging is temporarily unavailable, record an exact resumable dependency, and automatically resume the same operation only after exact Staging Live Certification succeeds.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A certified exact Production candidate reaches the required Staging Live Certification gate while local Windows Staging is stale or offline.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The controller records WAITING_FOR_STAGING without Production mutation; a later successful exact Staging Live Certification resolves the same open release/request identity against current trusted main and pinned Production, then re-dispatches the same governed promotion operation.
steps: Keep the release cut, request head, Production SHA, candidate SHA, and review mode exact.
Treat only staging_live_certification failure as a resumable external dependency; all other supporting-gate failures remain hard failures.
Publish an exact staging-resume marker and resumable manifest with merge/deployment false.
On a successful Staging Live Certification workflow_run, run only trusted current-main controller code.

Require current main to contain the authorized release cut, Production to remain pinned, candidate parent topology/tree to remain exact, and the request head to remain tree-identical to the release cut.
Re-dispatch the existing launcher from current main with the original exact release cut/request identity.
assertions: Advancing main with a descendant no longer invalidates the launcher merely because the trusted controller SHA differs from the older release cut.
A non-descendant main, changed Production ref, moved candidate/request branch, missing or ambiguous resume marker, or invalid review mode fails closed.
No Production merge, deployment, migration, database mutation, provider mutation, credential payload read, secret output, or force push is authorized.

phases.objective: Exercise one real offline-to-online Staging convergence and prove automatic resumption reuses the existing candidate surfaces.
Exercise duplicate workflow_run delivery, main advancement, Production movement, missing markers, and stale candidate branches with fail-closed behavior.
No provider or Production canary authority is added.
This change does not authorize Production merge or deployment.
